title: Can China Export Its Nuclear Boom?
gist: Gavekal teaser: China is the biggest builder of nuclear plants but has exported only to Pakistan; it can't win by ultralow prices as in solar/EVs, yet within a decade should become an important exporter via low cost, fast construction and state financing.

insights.claim: China is the world's biggest builder of nuclear power plants but, unlike in other energy sectors, is not yet a significant reactor exporter; its only overseas projects are in Pakistan, a close strategic ally.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Chinese nuclear export is still nascent, so current export-market share is a base for upside, not an existing threat.
insights.locator: China is the world’s biggest builder

insights.claim: The international reactor market is still dominated by Russia, with South Korea starting to win projects in the Middle East and Europe with its low-cost models.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Rosatom and Korean vendors are the incumbents China must displace; Korean wins show price-competitive demand exists.
insights.locator: The international market is still dominated by Russia

insights.claim: Chinese nuclear firms can make reactors relatively cheaply, but nuclear's complexity and safety needs mean they cannot gobble up world markets through ultralow prices as Chinese solar, EV and battery firms did.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Do not extrapolate the solar/EV price-war playbook to nuclear; disruption will be slower.
insights.quote: the complexity and safety needs of nuclear projects mean they will never be able to gobble up world markets through ultralow prices
insights.locator: China is the world’s biggest builder

insights.claim: Over the next decade China will likely become an important nuclear exporter thanks to a combination of low cost, quick construction time and state-backed financing support.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Long-horizon risk for Russian and Korean vendors and a tailwind for Chinese nuclear supply chain; watch new export deals beyond Pakistan.
